run_deformable_cloth_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a cloth soft body and steps the physics loop
create_soft_body_with_parameters: create a soft body from an OBJ mesh with bending springs, mass-spring model, and friction settings
create_soft_body_anchor_to_rigid_body: create soft body anchors that attach cloth nodes to a rigid URDF box at specified local offsets
change_visual_shape_double_sided: change the visual shape of a soft body to render both sides of the mesh
get_mesh_data_simulation_vertices: get the simulation mesh vertex count and positions from a soft body for debug visualization
